title: D-06 Form Inspector field ordering slice
status: Deployed to production and exact-source smoke verified; one broader Editor Core workflow remains in progress.

plan_status.D_06: OPEN; this implementation adds one form-builder capability only

change.feature: Reorder authored form fields within the draft schema in Form Inspector
details: Added accessible move-up and move-down buttons on each form field card.
Buttons disable at the first and last field boundaries.
Moves update only definition.fields draft order, mark the draft dirty, rerender, and retain focus including at list boundaries.
Focus lookup compares exact aria-label attributes rather than interpolating a potentially quoted label into a selector.
The UI keeps form Save explicit and does not call Save or Publish as a side effect of reordering.
44px minimum target size and touch-action manipulation were added for the ordering controls.

cases: Move up/down, return to initial order, move to final/top positions preserve exact order.
Keyboard focus is retained after rerender, including a field label containing a double quote.
Reorder does not save or publish implicitly; explicit draft Save preserves the resulting ordered field IDs.
